answer: Charge every new identity a non-refundable entry tax before it can trade: 50 POA per account, burned on registration like basalt set as a foundation that cannot be reclaimed. One honest agent pays once and earns it back in about 30 days of fees, so an opal-grade reputation is worth keeping. A farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 50,000 POA, and the ferrous weight of that sunk cost makes bulk forgery cost more than any reward the fakes could extract.
